import HartshorneLib.Chapter4IntrinsicResidue
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4P1Residue

/-!
# Laurent-polynomial differentials and intrinsic residues

This file connects the Laurent coefficient bookkeeping on the overlap of the
two standard affine charts with the intrinsic residue at a closed point.  A
local parameter is used explicitly; the resulting residue identity is then a
direct consequence of the normalized monomial calculation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

private def laurentParameterUnit {x : X.left} (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) : X.left.functionFieldˣ :=
  Units.mk0 (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t)
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero)

/-- The rational differential obtained by evaluating a Laurent polynomial at a
local parameter and multiplying by the actual differential `dt` in the
function field. -/
def curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) (f : LaurentPolynomial k) :
    CurveRationalDifferentials X :=
  LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k X.left.functionField)
      (laurentParameterUnit X hx t ht) f •
    KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
      (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)

omit [IsAlgClosed k] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] in
@[simp]
theorem curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential_monomial {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) (a : k) (n : ℤ) :
    curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht
        (LaurentPolynomial.C a * LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
      a •
        (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ n •
          KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
            (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)) := by
  unfold curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential
  rw [map_mul, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_C, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_T]
  have hunit : (↑((laurentParameterUnit X hx t ht) ^ n) : X.left.functionField) =
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t) ^ n := by
    change (Units.coeHom X.left.functionField) ((laurentParameterUnit X hx t ht) ^ n) = _
    rw [map_zpow (Units.coeHom X.left.functionField)]
    exact congrArg (fun z : X.left.functionField => z ^ n)
      (Units.val_mk0 (a := algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t)
        (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero))
  simp only [mul_smul]
  rw [hunit]
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField]

@[simp]
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (f : LaurentPolynomial k) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx
      (curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht f) =
      laurentResidueAtZero f := by
  induction f using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
      have hadd : curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht (p + q) =
          curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht p +
            curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht q := by
        simp [curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential, map_add, add_smul]
      rw [hadd, map_add, hp, hq, (laurentResidueAtZero (k := k)).map_add]
  | C_mul_T n a =>
      rw [curveLaurentPolynomialDifferential_monomial, map_smul]
      rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidue_zpow_smul X hx t ht n]
      rw [laurentResidueAtZero_monomial]
      split <;> simp_all

omit [IsAlgClosed k] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] in
private theorem curve_differential_inv {x : X.left}
    (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) :
    KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField
        ((algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t)⁻¹) =
      - (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t)⁻¹ ^ 2 •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t) := by
  let u := algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t
  have hu : u ≠ 0 := map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero
  have h := (KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField).leibniz u u⁻¹
  have h' : u • (KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField u⁻¹) +
      u⁻¹ • (KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField u) = 0 := by
    simpa [u, hu] using h.symm
  have hdu : KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField u =
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
        (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t) := by
    exact (KaehlerDifferential.map_D k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      X.left.functionField t).symm
  have h'' := congrArg (fun z => u⁻¹ • z) h'
  simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hu, one_smul] at h''
  have hinv : KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField u⁻¹ =
      -u⁻¹ ^ 2 • KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField u := by
    rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h'']
    simp [pow_two]
  change KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField u⁻¹ = _
  rw [hinv, hdu]

/-- Evaluate a Laurent polynomial in the inverse coordinate and multiply by
the actual differential of that inverse coordinate. -/
def curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) (f : LaurentPolynomial k) :
    CurveRationalDifferentials X :=
  LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap k X.left.functionField)
      (laurentParameterUnit X hx t ht)⁻¹ f •
    KaehlerDifferential.D k X.left.functionField
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t)⁻¹

/-- The inverse-coordinate sign follows from the differential chain rule,
with the intrinsic residue still taken in the original local parameter. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidue_curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (f : LaurentPolynomial k) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidue X hx
      (curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht f) =
      -laurentResidueAtZero f := by
  induction f using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
      have hadd : curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht (p + q) =
          curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht p +
            curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht q := by
        simp [curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential, map_add, add_smul]
      rw [hadd, map_add, hp, hq, (laurentResidueAtZero (k := k)).map_add, neg_add]
  | C_mul_T n a =>
      let u := algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t
      have hu : u ≠ 0 :=
        map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr ht.ne_zero
      have hunit : (↑((laurentParameterUnit X hx t ht)⁻¹ ^ n) : X.left.functionField) =
          u⁻¹ ^ n := by
        change (Units.coeHom X.left.functionField) ((laurentParameterUnit X hx t ht)⁻¹ ^ n) = _
        rw [map_zpow (Units.coeHom X.left.functionField)]
        simp [laurentParameterUnit, u]
      have hpow : u⁻¹ ^ n * u⁻¹ ^ 2 = u ^ (-n - 2) := by
        calc
          _ = u ^ (-n) * u ^ (-2 : ℤ) := by
            simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_ofNat, inv_pow, inv_zpow]
          _ = u ^ (-n + (-2 : ℤ)) := (zpow_add₀ hu _ _).symm
          _ = _ := by congr 1
      have hmono : curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential X hx t ht
          (LaurentPolynomial.C a * LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
          (-a) • (u ^ (-n - 2) •
            KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
              (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t)) := by
        unfold curveInverseLaurentPolynomialDifferential
        rw [map_mul, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_C, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_T, hunit,
          curve_differential_inv X hx t ht]
        change (algebraMap k X.left.functionField a * u⁻¹ ^ n) •
          (-u⁻¹ ^ 2 • _) = _
        rw [mul_smul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField,
          smul_smul, mul_neg, hpow, neg_smul, smul_neg, neg_smul]
      rw [hmono, map_smul]
      rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidue_zpow_smul X hx t ht (-n - 2),
        laurentResidueAtZero_monomial]
      have hn : -n - 2 = -1 ↔ n = -1 := by omega
      simp only [hn]
      split <;> simp

end
end Hartshorne
